speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significantly elevated alkaline phosphatase and bilirubin, I suspect an obstructive cause. Do you have a history of gallstones or abdominal surgeries, and have you noticed any dark urine or pale, clay-colored stools? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder. No evident stones.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of painless jaundice, weight loss, and an enlarged gallbladder without stones is highly suggestive of pancreatic head cancer causing biliary obstruction. REQUEST TEST: CT_Pancreas

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CT scan is unexpected given the physical findings, so I need to rule out other causes of biliary obstruction. Have you noticed any fever, chills, or night sweats, and do you have any history of autoimmune diseases? REQUEST TEST: CA19-9

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal imaging and tumor markers, I must consider non-malignant obstructive causes like primary sclerosing cholangitis or autoimmune pancreatitis. Do you have a history of inflammatory bowel disease, and have you noticed any itching of the skin? REQUEST TEST: MRCP

speaker: Doctor
text: Since MRCP is normal, I must look for causes of cholestasis not visible on standard imaging, such as primary biliary cholangitis or drug-induced liver injury. Do you take any supplements or medications, and have you ever been tested for autoimmune markers like AMA? REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Hepatitis_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative workup for obstruction and autoimmune causes, I need to rule out infiltrative diseases or vascular issues. Have you had any recent travel or exposure to parasites, and do you have any known blood disorders? REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of painless jaundice, weight loss, and a distended gallbladder with negative imaging for masses strongly suggests lymphoma infiltrating the liver and biliary tree. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatic Lymphoma
